roads.strategic_importance: National Lifeline (100% of civilian goods and medical supplies into Sikkim)

chokepoints.geological_cause: Saturated phyllite shear face, intense thermal weathering (DTR 8.4°C)
Main Boundary Thrust (MBT) fault trace + Teesta river toe scour
Overland drainage concentration exceeding culvert discharge

roads.evacuation_advisory: Enforce heavy commercial vehicle convoy ban. Position emergency JCB loaders at Rangpo and Singtam checkpoints.
roads.alternate_route: Divert light vehicular traffic via Melli – Jorethang – Namchi – Singtam Axis.

roads.road_name: North Sikkim Highway (Gangtok - Dikchu - Mangan - Chungthang)
roads.strategic_importance: Critical Defense Arterial (Access to North Border & Hydroelectric Projects)

chokepoints.geological_cause: Extreme 42° slope + jointed gneiss rockfall chute
Main Central Thrust (MCT) active shear zone + river erosion

roads.evacuation_advisory: Total night transit suspension between Mangan and Chungthang. Deploy drone reconnaissance team.
roads.alternate_route: No paved alternate route exists. Helicopter medical air-evacuation standby required.

chokepoints.geological_cause: Moderate slope gradient with roadside drainage overflow

roads.evacuation_advisory: Maintain normal traffic with 30 km/h speed restriction on hill bends.
roads.alternate_route: Direct highway open; secondary route via Damthang bypass.

roads.road_name: West Sikkim Corridor (Jorethang - Legship - Geyzing - Pelling)

chokepoints.geological_cause: Rangit river undercutting + road embankment slumping

roads.evacuation_advisory: Single-lane transit only across Legship bridge. Station standby recovery tow-truck.
roads.alternate_route: Divert through Dentam – Hee Bermiok mountain road.

chokepoints.geological_cause: Extreme freeze-thaw shattered moraines + saturated glacial debris

roads.evacuation_advisory: High-altitude travel restricted to emergency military convoys with 4x4 traction only.
roads.alternate_route: Zero ground bypass available. Strict radio convoy checkpoints in effect.

emergencyPriorities.exposure: Critical arterial route + Military & Hydroelectric Infrastructure
emergencyPriorities.reason: Extreme 3-day rainfall (166 mm) + soil moisture (78%) on steep jointed gneiss face near active MCT fault.
emergencyPriorities.recommended_action: ENFORCE IMMEDIATE CONVOY HALT. Position heavy earthmovers at Chungthang and evacuate gorge residences.

emergencyPriorities.reason: 108 mm single-day rainfall burst causing acute pore-pressure spike on saturated phyllite slopes.
emergencyPriorities.recommended_action: Deploy SDRF road-clearing teams; initiate 24/7 radar debris-flow monitoring and divert traffic via Alternate Axis.

emergencyPriorities.location: Dikchu River Gorge & Dam Axis Road
emergencyPriorities.exposure: Hydropower project axis + connecting settlement bridge
emergencyPriorities.reason: Intense fluvial toe scour combined with 156 mm cumulative antecedent rainfall.
emergencyPriorities.recommended_action: Enforce controlled night traffic closure and sound siren early warnings for downstream settlements.

emergencyPriorities.exposure: District Headquarters supply line + rural hamlets
emergencyPriorities.reason: Severe overland flow concentration exceeding culvert capacity.
emergencyPriorities.recommended_action: Clear roadside drainage channels and position NDRF quick response vehicle at Mangan EOC.

alerts.title: RED ALERT: Imminent Landslide Trigger along NH-10 Singtam Gorge
alerts.detail: Layer 2 dynamic model detects critical failure threshold breach (166 mm 3-day rain + 78% SMAP soil saturation). High probability of active debris flow.

alerts.title: RED ALERT: High Threat on North Sikkim Highway at Chungthang
alerts.detail: Torrential precipitation surge over jointed rock faces near MCT fault zone. Slope failure probability exceeds 94%.
